Heads-up — I ran a quick smoke pass on our staging infra to validate the test harness. Observations and proposed mitigations:

Observations:
- Baseline latency at 100qps is ~210ms p99 on A100 test nodes with default batching. Memory headroom is OK for 64-token sequences, but sustained 100qps pushes KV cache evictions on smaller instances.
- We will need a short script to pin the KV cache between runs; otherwise flakiness will impact acceptance signal fidelity.

Proposed mitigations (owners):
- KV pinning script + runbook: karthik_iyer (runbook_draft.md attached)
- Canary orchestration adjustments (smaller ramp steps, golden dataset): marissa_cole
- Short-term capacity bump for joint dry-run: propose we enable an extra 2x burst slot on the dedicated pool for Oct 26 dry-run (Hannah to approve)

Adding the runbook draft as a starting point. I can turn the KV pin into a small pre-flight hook that runs before perf suites.

[Attachment: runbook_draft.md (text/markdown, 4KB)]

-karthik
